dict.string: DMS uses System Events and Automation for power menu actions (Log Out, Restart, Shut Down), media playback integration, and window management.
DMS reads and creates calendar events for the DankDash calendar overview.
DMS reads and creates calendar events for the DankDash calendar overview.
DMS uses Location Services so macOS CoreWLAN can read the active Wi-Fi network name (SSID) and scan nearby networks.
DMS uses Device Control & Accessibility to intercept hardware media and volume keys, manage virtual workspaces, and detect running application windows.
DMS uses Input Monitoring to observe hardware media and brightness keys to replace the native system bezel HUD.
DMS uses Bluetooth to display and toggle adapter power in the control center.
